title: ছড়ায় সত্যানুসরণ
description: In Chhoray Satyanusaran, I take up Thakur’s Satyanusaran a passage at a time and render it in Bengali verse. During revision I keep the original passage beside each poem.

title: Satyanusaran Decoded
description: A reader’s companion to the same text. In prose, I work through the sections in order and ask what each one might mean in everyday life.

title: The Sandipan Ray series
description: Sayak Roy and I are writing a detective series set in contemporary Kolkata. Sandipan notices what people overlook. His companion sees things with a filmmaker’s eye. We want the reader to have a fair chance of solving the mystery alongside them.
